customer: Hello, my household is going down to one car, so I'd like to sell my hybrid sedan here in California. Would I need to book an appointment to get it looked at, or can I just stop by a store? I'd appreciate knowing what to expect.
agent: Thanks for reaching out! No appointment is needed. You can walk into any Northwind store, and a specialist will inspect your hybrid sedan while you wait, usually in 30 to 45 minutes, and give you a written quote that's valid for 7 days or 300 miles. If you accept, you can finish the sale during the same visit, so bring your photo ID, registration and title, or your payoff information if you still have a loan.
